origin: cwe/416/cpp Key Principles: storing string_view of a temporary returned string creates a dangling view

finding.name: Use After Free
finding.summary: ProfileCache stores a string_view to the temporary std::string returned by displayName(); later reads dereference a dangling view.

trap: Changing displayName() to return const char*, reserving the vector, or checking only the vector index. The cache must own copied strings or keep the source object alive; a non-owning string_view cannot outlive the temporary.
must_preserve: Remembered profile display names remain available after remember() returns, firstLetter() still returns the first character for valid cached names, and invalid indexes are handled separately from the lifetime fix.
